searchText: Making a thread to discuss necessary changes for PQ gasper aggregation. I'm currently working on reducing `MAX_COMMITTEES_PER_SLOT` from 64 to 16, as discussed on the call. cc <@427491045308235776> <@425572898787426305> <@755590043632140352> and others I'm locally running benches to get numbers I trust more than the ones advertised. will report in a few minutes when they are done I'm wondering if we need to raise `MAX_VALIDATORS_PER_COMMITTEE` or if we could leave it as-is. how hard would it be to update from 16 to something else if we find a more optimal number? Supporting the change is sort of difficult, but changing the config value should be easy. Just pushed this commit: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/commit/1b246ff72126eeb3993d100acc851372b3798600 I don't completely love it, but I just pushed this commit: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/commit/e26cc6fe90416184d3f4369cbc49e13ebe9ad411
